info.title: com.clodhub/reservations
info.description: The shop's bookings: availability from the calendars and opening hours, a booking request quoted, checked and priced (member prices, gift cards, home visits, deposits), the deposit paid through a checkout or an app's payment sheet, the booking read by its id and the customer's token or by the customer's address, and cancellation by the customer or the owner. Server only; every collaborator is passed in, and emails are the application's (notify).

methods.name: createReservations
methods.description: The booking service: it checks the collaborators it is given and keeps bookings in the records store.

methods.name: Reservations.ensureIndexes
methods.description: Creates the reservations collection's indexes: clientEmail, date and time, status, createdAt (newest first), checkoutId (sparse), and both cancellation tokens (unique, sparse).

methods.name: Reservations.scheduleInfo
methods.description: The schedule in force for the booking page: its hours, closed days, days by appointment and when it was chosen.

methods.name: Reservations.availability
methods.description: The starts a booking of this length can take on a date: INVALID_DURATION outside booking-policy's limits, INVALID_DATE when the date is not YYYY-MM-DD, TOO_SOON before the earliest bookable date; no slots on a closed day or when the calendars cannot be reached.

methods.name: Reservations.quote
methods.description: The price of a booking before it is asked for, as reserve prices it, in the request's language; MISSING_FIELDS when the lines cannot be read.

methods.name: Reservations.reserve
methods.description: Checks a booking request and books it: confirmed at once when no deposit is due, else the deposit's payment with metadata kind reservation and reservationId: a checkout that ends at booking-policy's checkoutExpiry from the booking's createdAt, or an app's sheet payment. A payment that cannot start cancels the booking (checkout_failed) and answers CHECKOUT_FAILED. The answer names the booking's id and the customer's token. A filled honeypot stores nothing. The address is kept in lower case. Prices come from the catalogue, through member pricing with a member code; a gift card must be usable and not held by more open bookings (confirmed, or awaiting payment for less than holdMinutes) than it has sessions left. The time is checked against the busy calendars just before the booking is stored (SLOT_TAKEN stores nothing); a calendar that cannot be reached lets it through. Store failures throw.

methods.name: Reservations.find
methods.description: The booking with this id whose customer's token this is (not the owner's), as BookingView; null for any other id or token (text of 1 to 200 characters).

methods.name: Reservations.bookingsByEmail
methods.description: The bookings made with an address (trimmed, in lower case), soonest first (by startsAt, then id), in every state, as BookingView; with endsAfter only those ending after it. Text that is not an address gives []. For a customer's wallet: the application confirms the address (com.clodhub/email-verification) first.

endsAfter.description: A JavaScript Date; shown here as its ISO 8601 text.

methods.name: Reservations.confirmPayment
methods.description: Settles a booking from its completed checkout (a com.clodhub/payments CheckoutSummary with metadata kind reservation): ignored unless the booking awaits payment and the checkout paid exactly its deposit in its currency. The lead time is checked again against the booking's createdAt and the time against the calendars; if either fails the booking is cancelled (too_late, slot_lost) and the deposit refunded with the idempotency key refund:<id>, else it is confirmed, its event made and the confirmed notice sent. A repeated or concurrent call settles a booking once.

methods.name: Reservations.preview
methods.description: What a cancellation token shows: null for an unknown token or a booking still awaiting payment.

methods.name: Reservations.cancel
methods.description: Cancels a confirmed booking by either token, once (the booking is claimed before anything else): the owner's token refunds the deposit in full, the customer's only before the free cancellation deadline; a late customer cancellation uses up the gift card's session; the calendar event is deleted and the cancelled notice sent.

methods.name: Reservations.status
methods.description: The status of the booking a checkout paid for, for the success page: null for an unknown checkout.

methods.name: Reservations.eventText
methods.description: The calendar event's summary and description for a booking, in the labels' words (the deps' labels by default).

activeSchedule.description: () => Promise of the schedule in force, as com.clodhub/opening-hours ActiveSchedule.get gives it: {schedule, updatedAt}.

leadDays.description: Whole days from today to the first bookable date (opening-hours' leadDays setting).

bufferMinutes.description: Free time between bookings at the shop (appointment-slots' bufferMinutes setting).

stepMinutes.description: Minutes between offered starts (appointment-slots' stepMinutes setting).

giftCards.description: Optional: a com.clodhub/gift-cards service (usable, cardValue, consume, currency). Without it every gift card code is GIFT_CARD_INVALID.

memberPricing.description: Optional: a com.clodhub/member-pricing service (activeRule, resolveItemPrice). Without it every member code is MEMBER_CODE_INVALID.

homeVisits.description: Optional: the com.clodhub/home-visits module with `base` (the shop's Point), `eligibleSlugs` and `settings` (HomeVisitSettings). Without it a home visit is HOME_VISIT_INELIGIBLE.

notify.description: (event: ReservationEvent) => Promise: the application renders and sends the emails. A failure is logged and never undoes a booking.
